summary: Independent re-verification of the WALLET_RAZORPAY_AND_ADMIN spec (Part A wallet-field rename + migration + demo-topup removal; Part B env-driven admin allowlist + admin_bypass on /analyze). ALL 15 review-request checks PASS. Backend: (1) NEW /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_razorpay_admin.py 28/28 pass in 8s against the public preview URL — covers: zero legacy balance_usd rows post-startup (verified count_documents==0), every wallet doc keyed by `balance`, GET /api/wallet/balance returns the real balance from the `balance` field, POST /api/wallet/topup now 404 (removed), admin phone (+918446307145) sees is_admin=true + enforcement_enabled=false on /wallet/balance, admin with balance=0.0 can POST /api/analyze -> 200 status=running billed=false admin_bypass=true balance still 0.0, identical non-admin (+919999000111) with 0.0 gets 402 'Insufficient balance', /api/pay/order returns 200 with order_id/amount=5/currency=USD/checkout_url and writes a `payments` doc whose wallet_key==`user:<uid>` even when a bogus device_id is passed in the body, /api/pay/order rejects amounts (1,3,7,100,0) with 400, /api/pay/checkout/{oid} returns text/html 200, /api/pay/callback with forged signature returns 400 and does NOT credit, /api/pay/webhook without or with an invalid X-Razorpay-Signature returns 400, all 4 protected endpoints return 401 without a Bearer token, all 5 public endpoints (/quote /chart /news /markets/trending /trending) still 200 without auth, analyses collection contains ZERO docs with a user_id field (assert count_documents==0), require_admin exists in server.py but no route calls Depends(require_admin), and +918446307145 does NOT appear inline anywhere except on the ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS default in server.py:952 (asserted with a source grep across server.py, auth.py, wallet.py, razorpay_pay.py). (2) NEW /app/backend/tests/test_admin_email_live_swap.py 1/1 pass in 10s — rewrote ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS to 'ops-live-swap@example.com', restarted backend via supervisorctl, minted a fresh email-only user with balance=0.0, confirmed GET /api/wallet/balance returned is_admin=true enforcement_enabled=false, and POST /api/analyze returned 200 billed=false admin_bypass=true — proving the allowlist is env-driven and supports email as well as phone. .env restored to ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS=+918446307145 afterwards. (3) Paid path + cache-hit: charging $0.25 on a fresh MSFT run debits balance from 5.00 to 4.75, an immediate re-check returns served_from_cache=true billed=false with balance unchanged. (4) Pre-existing 40 unit tests in test_auth.py + test_wallet.py + test_razorpay.py still 40/40 pass. FRONTEND (390x844, admin OTP=649316 and 875392 delivered via AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP=true, restored to false afterwards): (5) Admin (+918446307145) login -> Agents tab -> WalletCard (data-testid=wallet-card) renders '$0.00' balance, +$5/+$10/+$25 buttons all present, price note 'Full analysis: $0.25 · re-checking an unchanged verdict is free', 'Secure payment by Razorpay. Cards, UPI and netbanking.' footer. (6) Admin Analyze tab shows NO balance chip (data-testid=wallet-balance-chip is absent) and body contains NO 'ADD FUNDS' text — matches spec: admin bypasses UI enforcement. (7) Non-admin (+919999000112) login -> Analyze tab HOME shows the wallet-balance-chip pill in the top-right reading '$0.00' — enforcement UI is active for non-admins. Fresh users have no wallet doc, so the balance chip legitimately reads $0.00. The greyed-out 'ADD FUNDS — $0.25 NEEDED' Execute button is code-verified at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:460 (rendered when needsFunds=(WALLET_ENFORCEMENT && balance<price)) — the render couldn't be exercised because clicking an AAPL card from the browse grid did not route to the analyze detail in the automated Playwright session (row taps didn't propagate through the RN-web Pressable), but the code path is protected by the exact same flag as the balance chip, which we did see render. No red screen; auth gate, tab bar, Razorpay integration, wallet card and balance chip all rendered without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:993-998 wallet_key_for prefers `user:<id>` for any signed-in user and only falls back to a client-supplied device_id for anonymous callers — this is what makes the /pay/order device_id-in-body a no-op for authenticated users; verified end-to-end with the bogus-device-id test.

server.py:952 ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS reads os.environ.get('ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS', '+918446307145') — the +91 phone appears only as the env default so the super-user works out of the box; grep confirmed no other file references the literal, so the allowlist is truly env-driven.
server.py:971-979 require_admin is defined but never referenced (grep shows only its own def line); the source-inspection test also asserts no Depends(require_admin) exists — spec compliant.
server.py:1004-1010 is_admin() bridges au.is_admin(ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS) with the legacy wal.is_admin_phone(ADMIN_PHONES) so an older deployment's env keeps working — additive, non-breaking.

server.py:1722-1773 /analyze billing block: admin_bypass = is_admin(user); billed = WALLET_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED and not admin_bypass — the entire cached/live/charge branch is skipped for admins and the response fields (billed, price_charged, admin_bypass) are set consistently.

server.py:1820-1837 migrate_legacy_wallet_field runs on startup, takes max(balance, balance_usd), $unsets balance_usd — verified 0 legacy rows remain and the migration is idempotent (subsequent restarts are no-ops).

server.py:1042-1060 /api/wallet/balance returns enforcement_enabled = WALLET_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED and not admin — this is the single flag WalletBalanceChip.tsx:26 reads to hide itself for admins; the UI-side check matched the backend-side behaviour exactly in the admin flow.

server.py:1177-1181 /api/pay/callback verifies the Razorpay signature BEFORE settle_payment, and settle_payment re-fetches from Razorpay and only credits on status=='captured' — forged signatures cannot credit (verified).
server.py:1193-1225 /api/pay/webhook verifies X-Razorpay-Signature over the raw body first (raises 400 on failure) and dedupes by X-Razorpay-Event-Id — verified.
analyses collection has ZERO docs with a user_id field (count_documents==0) and no route links analyses to a user — privacy constraint satisfied.
Pre-existing minor: two DeprecationWarnings for @app.on_event(startup/shutdown) — FastAPI recommends the lifespan handler pattern. Non-blocking, no functional impact.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Backend .env has PUBLIC_BASE_URL as another public-URL source. The public URL is https://trade-agent-app.preview.emergentagent.com. To hit auth-gated routes from pytest use auth.create_session_token(uid, os.environ['JWT_SECRET']) after inserting a users doc directly in Mongo — that pattern is codified in test_wallet_razorpay_admin.py's _mk_user helper. For UI flows you must set AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP=true + restart backend to read the code from the on-screen 'DEV MODE — code: XXXXXX' banner (the API doesn't leak it to a headless caller); DON'T forget to flip it back. The frontend Analyze grid uses a Pressable that Playwright's element.click() on a text-node ancestor does NOT reliably invoke via evaluate() — if you need to open an analysis detail, tap via page.get_by_text('AAPL', exact=True).click(force=True) after wait_for_selector, or use the search bar. Free-credits behavior is intentionally absent from this codebase — do not require free_credits_remaining on any response. Legacy `balance_usd` field is gone from all wallet docs; if you see any regress, run the startup migration by restarting backend.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Every review-request assertion held: wallet field rename + migration is complete (0 legacy rows), /api/wallet/topup is removed (404), admin bypass works via env-driven allowlist for BOTH phone AND email, non-admins are blocked with 402, Razorpay order/callback/webhook signature-guarding is intact, wallet_key_for ignores client-supplied device_id for signed-in users, no endpoint exposes another user's data, require_admin exists but is unused, and the admin phone is not hardcoded outside the single ADMIN_IDENTIFIERS default line.
